strengths: Strong, consistent synthwave look: neon pink grid floor, glowing sun bars on the horizon, dark crystal spires, magenta light beams, bloom used throughout
The arena is a real modeled object with raised neon edges, corner posts and a checkered floor, set inside a deep 3D world with floating rings, cubes and drifting particles
Food is easy to spot with its vertical light beam and ground ring; eating sets off a ring shockwave and sparkles in the scene itself
Game over moves the camera in on a modeled snake head with eyes and shows a 'NEW BEST' badge, a thoughtful finishing touch
Clean, on-theme overlay panels for the title and game over screens; all 13 browser checks pass with 0 page errors, and the autopilot ate 22 foods in 40 s
weaknesses: Poor readability during play: the snake and food are tiny and sit at the far edge of a huge board, so the main action takes up only a few pixels while the empty foreground fills the screen
The busy background (floating shapes, strong bloom glare from the sun and cubes, big pink beams) competes with the playfield for attention
HUD labels (SCORE, BEST, LEVEL) are very small and low-contrast, and the numbers are plain
The snake's body segments are small spheres that blur together under the glow at gameplay distance; the eating effect is hard to see at that scale
On the phone the board is small and partly covered by the title panel, and the HUD text is barely readable
oneLine: A good-looking, cohesive synthwave 3D scene with real polish touches (game-over close-up, food beams, spatial eat effects), held back by a camera that leaves the snake and food tiny and hard to read against a busy background.
